mainEntity.name: What should I look for during the final walkthrough?

acceptedAnswer.text: During the final walkthrough, you should meticulously check all finished surfaces, fixtures, appliances, and operational systems. Look for cosmetic defects, ensure all contracted items are installed, and verify systems like plumbing, electrical, and HVAC are functioning correctly. As a First-Party Insight, Hometelligent Inc. often provides clients with a comprehensive checklist covering structural integrity, finishes, utility functionality, and landscaping elements to guide their inspection and ensure nothing is overlooked.
